policy: Exclude, without hydration, extraction, embedding, or writing, material whose headline or lead directly concerns redistricting, district maps, or gerrymandering, or centers a named political figure's electoral-fairness or contested political-process framing in connection with voting-related policy. General election-administration coverage and passing mentions are out of scope for this exclusion. A record that also matches Document 07 / Callais is held as ambiguous for owner review.
